rows.itemTitle: RENEWAL TERMINATION TRANSFER AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
rows.summary: Item 17 was substantially restructured: arbitration and related waivers were deleted in favor of Georgia courts in Atlanta, choice of law changed from Massachusetts to Georgia, transfer and non-compete conditions were expanded to owners/guarantors and Development Agreements, renewal conditions added default-history and other-franchise requirements, and several previously disclosed development-agreement fees and protections disappeared from the table.

atomicChanges.newValue: The Restaurant Brand Amendment adopts the Franchise Agreement's dispute resolution terms (Puerto Rico arbitration, FA forum) and New York choice of law.

newEvidence.quote: Restaurant Brand Amendment Same as Franchise Agreement.
Restaurant Brand Amendment Same as Franchise Agreement.

atomicChanges.reason: The new Restaurant Brand Amendment adopts existing Franchise Agreement dispute governance rather than creating a new forum or law; limited incremental economic meaning.
atomicChanges.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that the Franchise Agreement's forum or choice-of-law provisions changed, or that the Restaurant Brand Amendment was ever adopted.

atomicChanges.variableName: During-term non-compete covenant extended to management company
atomicChanges.subclauseLabel: q. Non-competition covenants during the term – FA §§1, 5.1.29, 7.2 and 7.3
atomicChanges.oldValue: Covenant bound the franchisee and its Affiliates from owning or being a licensor/franchisor of a competing hotel brand.
atomicChanges.newValue: Covenant also binds the franchisee's management company (if any), together with the franchisee and its Affiliates.

oldEvidence.quote: You and your Affiliates may not, indirectly or directly, own or be a licensor or franchisor of a hotel brand that competes with the System, a System Hotel or Network Hotel in our sole judgment, but you may own a minority interest in a Competitor under certain circumstances, and you may be a franchisee of a Competitor, or manage a property of a Competitor.

newEvidence.quote: You, your Affiliates, and your management company (if any) may not, indirectly or directly, own or be a licensor or franchisor of a hotel brand that competes with the System, a System Hotel or Network Hotel in our sole judgment, but you may own a minority interest in a Competitor under certain circumstances, and you may be a franchisee of a Competitor, or manage a property of a Competitor.

atomicChanges.reason: The during-term non-compete covenant is expanded to cover the franchisee's management company, broadening the scope of persons bound by the restriction.
atomicChanges.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that any management company actually became subject to or violated the covenant.

atomicChanges.variableName: Integration clause enumerated documents: Term Sheet removed
atomicChanges.subclauseLabel: t. Integration/merger clause – FA §16.4
atomicChanges.oldValue: Enforceable documents explicitly included the Franchise Agreement, the Term Sheet, the Application, the Guaranty, and other signed related agreements, plus representations in the franchise disclosure document.
atomicChanges.newValue: The Term Sheet is no longer explicitly listed; the enforceable documents are the Franchise Agreement, the Application, the Guaranty, and other signed related agreements, with a separate sentence preserving the franchise disclosure document statements.

oldEvidence.quote: Only the terms of the Franchise Agreement, the Term Sheet, the Application, the Guaranty and any other related agreements signed by the parties (and any representations in the franchise disclosure document) are enforceable (subject to state law). Any other promises may not be enforceable.

newEvidence.quote: Only the terms of the Franchise Agreement, the Application, the Guaranty and any other related agreements signed by the parties are enforceable (subject to state law). Any other promises may not be enforceable. However, nothing in this section disclaims the statements made in our franchise disclosure document.

atomicChanges.reason: The integration clause's enumerated enforceable documents change: the Term Sheet is removed from the explicit list while the franchise disclosure document statements are separately preserved.
atomicChanges.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that Term Sheet terms are unenforceable, because the Term Sheet may still qualify as another signed related agreement; only the explicit enumeration changed.

atomicChanges.variableName: Managed-to-Franchised Conversion Mortgage Lender LCL requirement
atomicChanges.subclauseLabel: m. Conditions for our approval of transfer – FA §12.4
atomicChanges.newValue: In a Managed-to-Franchised Conversion, the franchisee must cause each Mortgage Lender to sign an LCL under which the lender agrees not to disturb or interfere with franchisor rights and to assume (or cause the transferee to assume) Franchise Agreement obligations and any Development Incentive Note if the lender acquires the Hotel.

oldEvidence.quote: We may issue our consent in the form of a “lender comfort letter” agreement in a form satisfactory to us, and may include an estoppel and general release of claims. We charge a fee for the processing of a lender comfort letter.

newEvidence.quote: In a Managed-to-Franchised Conversion, you must cause each Mortgage Lender to sign an LCL in the form required by us under which the Mortgage Lender agrees not to disturb or interfere with our rights under the Franchise Agreement and to assume (or cause the transferee to assume) your obligations under the Franchise Agreement and any Development Incentive Note if the Mortgage Lender or other transferee acquires possession or ownership of the Hotel. The specific form of LCL cannot be determined in advance because it would depend on the specific circumstances. Accordingly, it would be provided at the time of origination.

atomicChanges.reason: A new mandatory lender LCL obligation is introduced for Managed-to-Franchised Conversions, adding a condition to the franchisor's consent and the conversion process.
atomicChanges.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that any conversion occurred, that any LCL was signed, or the form of any LCL actually used.
